newsitem.title: USA: Robert Sarnoff, former NBC president dies at 78.
newsitem.headline: Robert Sarnoff, former NBC president dies at 78.

text.p: Robert Sarnoff, the son of broadcasting radio pioneer David Sarnoff who built the Radio Corporation of America (RCA) into a giant corporation, died on Saturday, according to WNBC television. He was 78.
The station said the cause was cancer and that he had been ill for several months.
Sarnoff was chairman of the board at RCA from 1970 to 1975. He also headed NBC until 1965. RCA, the parent company of NBC, has since been purchased by General Electric.
He is survived by his wife, Anna Moffo, the opera singer, three daughters and two brothers.
